visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young woman with long, straight brown hair wearing an elegant white off-the-shoulder top and a long, pleated beige skirt. She is walking through a brightly lit, high-end retail store with white shelves and pastel-colored product packaging. The setting is clean and modern, with soft studio lighting reflecting off polished surfaces. (2) The camera transitions to close-up shots of her picking up and examining various beauty products, such as jars of body scrub and bottles of fragrance. The shelves behind her are meticulously organized, labeled with headers like 'Musk' and 'Dead Sea'. She smiles warmly, her facial expressions showing delight and engagement with the environment. (3) The focus shifts to a specific product line featuring 'Vitamin C'. The woman is seen holding a large gift box containing multiple pink-packaged products. Macro shots highlight the texture of a thick, golden body scrub being scooped with a small wooden spoon and applied to her hand. (4) Detailed close-ups follow, showing the application of different skincare items including a white cream and a clear facial oil using a dropper. Her hands are adorned with gold rings, and her nails are long and manicured. A staff member's hands briefly appear to help rinse the scrub off with a stream of water over a sink. (5) In the final segment, the woman is shown holding two branded shopping bags (one white, one pink) and waving at the camera with a cheerful, satisfied expression. The video concludes with a static shot of the 'LALINE' logo in a decorative frame on a white background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a cheerful female voiceover introducing the store location over an upbeat, mid-tempo synth-pop track. The music has a clear electronic beat with bright synthesizer pads. (2) As the narrator begins describing the brand and product types, the BGM continues consistently. A slight sound of a lid opening or a click can be heard during the product close-ups. (3) During the 'Vitamin C' product demonstration, the narrator's tone becomes more descriptive and informative. The sound of running water and gentle splashing is audible as the scrub is rinsed off. (4) The final phase features the narrator inviting viewers to visit the store, her pitch rising slightly to convey enthusiasm. The BGM concludes with a clean fade-out alongside the closing logo.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Showcase -> Texture Demo -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial promotion for the LALINE beauty brand's Vitamin C skincare collection. By showcasing the aesthetic store environment and demonstrating the tactile quality and application of specific products like scrubs and serums, it aims to attract customers to visit their new branch in LaLaport, Taipei.
